text.jp:
おう、どうした、ぼうずども。
このグザランに何か話でもあるってのか？
text.official_en:
Hey, kids. Got something you need to discuss with
ol' Guzran?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やっぱり、強い人を雇って戦力を増やすのが、
こういうときの定石だと思うのよね。
text.official_en:
I suppose the thing to do in this kind of situation is to
hire fighters to join us, huh?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど……ぼくたちみたいな子供に近付く
大人なんて、信用していいのかな……
text.official_en:
But...can we really trust the kind of adults who'd
want to fight with us? We're just kids.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そこは、ちゃんと相手を見極めるしかないわ。
強い人なら、お金もそれなりに必要になるかも。
text.official_en:
You're right. Lots of people could try to scam us.
That's why we have to use our good judgment.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大剣闘祭ってさ、例の怖い王様とか
目つきの悪い臣下の人たちだけじゃなくて、
text.official_en:
So in the Heroic Games, not only do we have to deal
with that scary queen and her mean-looking crew...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザ中から強い人達が集まるんだよね？
ぼくたち、本当に大丈夫かなあ……
text.official_en:
we also have to go up against the strongest fighters
in Dagda? Are...are we really going to be OK?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、カイのお父さまを助けるには、
これしか手がないじゃない。
text.official_en: We have to be, if we want to save Cai's dad.
text.real_en: We have to be, if we want to save Kai's dad.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
うう……せめてどこかで訓練できたら
もうちょっと自信つくかもしれないけど……
text.official_en:
Argh... If I could go train somewhere a little, I might
feel a bit less like a walking target...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それなら、闘技場に備えられてないかしら。
本で読んだことがあるの。
text.official_en:
I'm almost certain I read about a training area
somewhere in the arena.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、ぼくたちみたいな子供が
そんな施設、利用させてもらえるのかな。
text.official_en: Do you think they'll let a bunch of kids use it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうね……セントリオンさんに
相談したら、使わせてもらえないかしら。
text.official_en:
Oh yeah, hmmm... We should talk to Centurio.
I imagine he can get us permission.
text.real_en: Right... Maybe if we ask Centurio-san, he'll let us use it.

うん。
後でおっさんに話してみよう。
text.official_en: Yeah, we'll try talking to him later.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
御子様、いかがですかな。
このダグシオンにはもう慣れましたか？
text.official_en:
Cai, I trust you're well. I hope you're getting used to
life in Dagsion.
text.real_en:
Kai, I trust you're well. I hope you're getting used to
life in Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
訓練場を利用したいと？
むむむ……申し訳ございません。
text.official_en:
You'd like to use the training grounds? I'm sorry, but
that won't be possible.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この時期は大剣闘祭の関係者以外には
開放されぬ決まりとなっておりまして……
text.official_en:
At the present time, access to it is limited to those
participating in the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私は法の番人。決まりを破ることは出来ません。
御子様のご希望といえど、如何ともしがたく……
text.official_en:
I understand your desire to get into the training
grounds, but I cannot bend the rules for anyone.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガブリエル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんだ？　ここは子供の遊び場じゃねえぞ。
ったく、どっから入り込みやがった。
text.official_en:
Hey! This isn't a playground! How'd you kids even
get in here, anyway?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガブリエル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここから先は立入禁止だ。
ぶらぶらしてねえで、とっとと出ていくんだ。
text.official_en:
Everything up ahead's off limits to you. Get out!
No hanging around!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
え？　あなたたち、
闘技場の中の訓練場を利用したいの？
text.official_en:
You guys want to use the training grounds inside
the arena?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ごめんなさい、大剣闘祭の開催期間の間は
参加者の利用が最優先になっていて、
text.official_en:
Sorry, but we have to give participants in the Heroic
Games top priority for that space.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一般の人は利用できなくなっているの。
ごめんなさいね。
text.official_en: Regular members of the public can't use it.

text.official_en: <TH>

The exam for additional participants is at noon on
<#CTRL:0E>

追加募集の試験は今日の正午からよ。
準備ができたら声をかけてね。
text.official_en:
The participant exam is today at noon! When you're
ready, give me a shout.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
久しぶりにじっくりとカストールと
話すことができて、本当に嬉しかったけど、
text.official_en:
That was so nice. It's been such a long time since I
was able to talk with Castor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それよりも、カイくんがこんなに大きく
立派に育ってくれたことが何よりもよかったわ。
text.official_en:
Even more than that, I'm glad that you've grown up
so splendidly, Cai!
text.real_en:
Even more than that, I'm glad that you've grown up
so splendidly, Kai-kun!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえば……
カストールはもう行ってしまったの？
text.official_en:
Speaking of which, has Castor been taken back to
his cell already?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そう……カイくんも辛かったわよね。
わたくしたちのせいで、ごめんね。
text.official_en:
It must be so hard for you, Cai. Please understand.
None of this is your fault.
text.real_en:
It must be so hard for you, Kai-kun. Please understand.
None of this is your fault.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わたくし、本当はカストールの助命を
お願いするために
text.official_en: I've hoped to plead for Castor's life.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一度とうさまに会って、ちゃんと
お話しなければと思っているのだけど……
text.official_en: I thought if I could speak with Father just once...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ごめんなさい、それは……
わたくしが……怖くて……
text.official_en: Forgive me. I'm just... I'm scared.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
街の西側のアルシネウス門に人が集まっとる
ようじゃが、こりゃ、何の騒ぎかのう。
text.official_en:
What's all the fuss about? Lotta folks gathering
over on the west side of town, at Alcineus Gate.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ほらほら、にいちゃんも、
はやく行かないといい場所がとれないよ！
text.official_en: C'mon! You gotta hurry if you want a good spot!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
サラミスの女王は、たいそう美人なんだそうだ。
俺も、すぐに見に行かなけりゃ！
text.official_en:
I hear the queen of Saramis is a real beauty. I've got
to get eyes on her right away!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
なんだか、今日は朝から騒がしいねえ……
嘘だろ、サラミスの行列が通るのかい！？
text.official_en:
It's been noisy around here all morning. Is it time?
Is the queen of Saramis's procession happening?

text.jp:
こうしちゃいられない！
あたしもすぐに行かないと！
text.official_en: Enough standing around! I've got to get over there!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あんた、さっきあの女王から思い切り
ぶん殴られてた子供じゃないのかい？
text.official_en: Aren't you that kid who I saw the queen punch?

text.jp:
災難だったねえ……いくら
女王様だからって酷いことするもんだよ。
text.official_en:
So awful. I bet she thinks she can get away with
anything because she's royalty.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
サラミスの女王の右腕は、
岩をも砕くと言われていたが……
text.official_en:
I heard the queen of Saramis can punch through
rock with that right hook of hers.

text.jp:
それで殴られて、よく無事で済んだものだ。
女王が手を抜いたのか、それとも……
text.official_en:
So how come you caught one and came out OK?
Either the queen was pulling her punches, or...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
グザランって傭兵を知ってるかい？
呆れるくらいのホラ吹きなんだけどさ。
text.official_en:
Do you know a mercenary named Guzran? What a
braggart! I can hardly believe a word he says.

text.jp:
やれ、自分は竜を倒しただの、雲に乗っただの、
何が本当なんだか全然わかりゃしない。
text.official_en:
He's got stories about slaying dragons, riding clouds...
I haven't the foggiest if any of his stories are true.

text.jp:
……でも、顔の割には面倒見のいい奴でね。
近所の子供たちからも好かれてるみたいだよ。
text.official_en:
Still, he's really sweet. Not that you'd get that from
looking at him. And the local kids all love him.
